purpose: Replay every bracketed short-memory p,q surface row, scale neighbor, unfavorable control, and exact repeat with eight lens-geometry starts.
claim_boundary: Every one of the 47 refinement rows is replayed, so no favorable-only selection is possible.
All gravity and structural settings are frozen; only declared lens nuisance geometry is reoptimized.
The exact repeat group measures bridge-fit and lens-geometry repeatability independently of formula leverage.
Eight-start scores supersede shallow classifications for these rows.
A root loss or poor score applies only to that frozen row, not the parent mechanism.
